dedupe_keys.name: replication data for diversion of flow and sediment towards a side channel separated from a river by a longitudinal training dam

description: Wageningen provides replication data for field monitoring of flow and sediment diversion at a side-channel entrance separated from the Waal River by a longitudinal training dam. The custom coverage field identifies 2017 and 2018. Native metadata compares the field pattern with a uniform-depth potential-flow model and side-weir theory. It identifies sill geometry as a control on sediment exchange and morphological stability. Coverage: 2017/2018. Access: public native metadata identifies this release and its stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current distribution access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The source describes model comparisons without establishing an executable model in this release. Related laboratory sill-geometry experiments have a different native DOI. Exact variables, sampling and observation accuracy were not independently checked. Geographical scope follows the named Waal training-dam site. Its simulation use concerns the source-described comparison of river-infrastructure field measurements with flow models.
